packageRules.description: onnxruntime, torch and PyYAML publish no Python 3.15 wheels, which the CI jobs install

Runtime deps (ort, clap, pyo3, ...) ship in the published crates/wheel/binaries, unlike build tooling or dev/test deps -- re-enable 'fix' so their bumps read as behavior-relevant in history, overriding the shared preset's blanket 'chore'.
